'''Marvin Williams''' was a [[college]] [[basketball]] player for the [[University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill|University of North Carolina]]. He enrolled at North Carolina in [[2004]] and played one season before declaring himself eligible for the [[NBA Draft]]. He is widely expected to be one of the top two picks in the [[2005 NBA Draft]]. 

Marvin was a part of the [[University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill|University of North Carolina's]] 2004-2005 national championship basketball team.
